request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Change only the legs and remove the spike: it stands on exactly three legs, each twice as thick, dark gunmetal with round chrome silver knee joints (no brass, no yellow) and chunky round chrome feet; the pointed spike on the left of the head is removed. Keep the chrome hooded head, the big hot magenta eye lens, the heat-ray arm with its magenta tip, the height, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
